_comment: Grasp Chip queue for the distilled students, 20k-step generation (2026-11-26): students train for 20000 steps like gc_B, from the 20000-step checkpoints of gc_A and gc_B, saving every 2500 steps, wandb offline. The earlier gc_C (10k steps from gc_A/10000) stays in outputs/training/pi05/gc/gc_C; the 20k control is gc_C20. Paths are relative to cwd; lower priority number runs first. chosen_w.txt holds the w to train D with (e.g. `2`). Memory figures from the batch-64 test: student card 53 GB reserved, both teachers 31 GB reserved; a job takes one card with room for everything, otherwise the student on one card and the frozen teachers on a second. A card that already runs a TacGuide process is never shared, and only `allowed_gpus` are considered. First launch uses --overwrite (the trainer refuses an existing run directory); once a checkpoint exists the resume command is used. Do not wrap jobs in `systemd-run --user`: scopes under user@<uid>.service fall under the memory daemon 50% pressure-kill rule on this machine; start the scheduler from a plain ssh session in a tmux server of its own.

jobs.name: train_gc_D
jobs.cmd: source training/tacguide_env.sh && WANDB_MODE=offline PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True $TG/venv/bin/python training/tacguide/train_distill.py gc_D_w{w} --exp-name gc_D_w{w} --overwrite --steps 20000 --save-interval 2500 --teacher-step 20000 --weak-step 20000 --wandb {placement_args}
jobs.resume_cmd: source training/tacguide_env.sh && WANDB_MODE=offline PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True $TG/venv/bin/python training/tacguide/train_distill.py gc_D_w{w} --exp-name gc_D_w{w} --resume --steps 20000 --save-interval 2500 --teacher-step 20000 --weak-step 20000 --wandb {placement_args}

jobs.name: train_gc_C20
jobs.cmd: source training/tacguide_env.sh && WANDB_MODE=offline PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True $TG/venv/bin/python training/tacguide/train_distill.py gc_C --exp-name gc_C20 --overwrite --steps 20000 --save-interval 2500 --teacher-step 20000 --weak-step 20000 --wandb {placement_args}
jobs.resume_cmd: source training/tacguide_env.sh && WANDB_MODE=offline PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True $TG/venv/bin/python training/tacguide/train_distill.py gc_C --exp-name gc_C20 --resume --steps 20000 --save-interval 2500 --teacher-step 20000 --weak-step 20000 --wandb {placement_args}
